About This Video :

Home Insurance in Hindi | Ghar Ka Insurance Kaise Kare | Property Insurance India Explained. 
Agar aap jaana chahte hain ki Home Insurance kya hota hai, kaise kaam karta hai, aur claim kaise milta hai, to yeh video aapke liye hai.
Is video me maine Home / Property Insurance ko simple Hindi me explain kiya hai — including premium, claim process, structure cover vs content cover, aur tenant insurance.
 
Is Video Me Aap Seekhenge:

Home Insurance kya hota hai
Ghar ka insurance kaise kare
Structure Cover vs Content Cover
Fire, Flood, Earthquake cover hota hai ya nahi
Home Insurance claim process
Premium kitna hota hai
Claim reject hone ki wajah

 
Home Insurance ek affordable aur powerful financial protection tool hai jo aapko lakhon ke nuksaan se bachata hai.
Insurance lene se pehle policy wording dhyan se padhein aur sahi Sum Insured choose karein.
Video pasand aaye to Like, Share aur Subscribe zaroor karein.
